description: The plot illustrates how ACC (%) varies with Co-occurrence Number for six methods (Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME). The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale with major ticks shown at approximately 10, 100, and 1000, spanning from near 0 up to a few thousand. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” on a linear scale ranging from 60 to 85 with tick marks at 60, 65, 70, 75, 80, and 85. The Base line is black with circular markers and a solid line, increasing from about 61 at the leftmost point to about 67 at the rightmost point, with intermediate values near 63.5 and 65. The FT line is blue with downward triangle markers and a solid line, rising from about 62.5 to about 68.5 across the x-range (with midpoints around 65 and 67.5). The IKE line is red with upward triangle markers and a solid line, increasing from about 64.5 to about 70 (with midpoints around 67.8 and 69.2). The MEND line is brown with diamond markers and a solid line, moving upward from about 66 to about 74 (with midpoints around 71.2 and 73.5). The MEMIT line is purple with pentagon markers and a solid line, increasing from about 66.5 to about 72.5 (with midpoints around 70 and 71.2). The ROME line is green with square markers and a solid line, starting around 72.5 and rising to about 77.8 by the rightmost point, with intermediate values near 76 and 77.6 and a near-flat segment between the last two points.
